about: Assumptions for cost estimates (backend/tokenomics.py). These are assumptions, not measurements: token counts per assessment are measured in the evaluation runs; everything here is a stated input you can change.
proxy_reason: The course model gpt-5.6-luna has no verified price in data/model_prices.json. gpt-6-luna is the only model with a verified course price (MGT 409 Lecture 11, via HW 6), so it is used as a labelled proxy. The real cost of gpt-5.6-luna may be higher or lower.
assessments_reason: Assumption: a strategist screens about one feedstock stream or scenario per week. Change this to match real use.

other_costs.note: Not estimated: no verified quotes. These are separate from model costs and must be filled in from provider quotes.
